name: Ears
overview: Scripture reveals that ears are more than physical organs; they symbolize spiritual receptivity and obedience to God's word. Psalms 40:6 highlights God opening the ears rather than desiring sacrifices, emphasizing the importance of listening to His voice. Proverbs 20:12 reminds us that both hearing and seeing are divine gifts, while Isaiah 30:21 assures that God guides His people by speaking to their ears, directing their paths. The repeated call in Matthew 11:15 and 13:9 to those with ears to hear underscores the necessity of attentive listening for understanding and responding to Christ's message.
